Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, P. SATHASIVAM, AFTAB ALAM
13 S.C.R. 6 STATE OF M.P. v MUNN I BAI & ANR. (Criminal Appeal No. 1298 of 2002) AUGUST 28, 2008 [DR. ARJIT PASAYAT, P. SATHASIVAM AND AFTAB ALAM, JJ] Penal Code, 1860: C ss. 302134 and 328134 - Murder by poisoning - Conviction by trial court - Acquittal by High Court - HELD: High Court was contained poison did not know from where it came - There was no forensic examination of food item shared by witness and the deceased - Besides, motive for crime seemed to be improbable - Judgment of acquittal E passed by High Court upheld. CRIMINALAPPELLATE JURISDICTION : Criminal Appeal No. 1298
